title: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 – CA/CMA Intern Posts
shortInfo: NPCIL has announced notification for CA/CMA Intern posts. Required qualification: Inter CA, Inter CMA. Last date to apply: 26-10-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Submission of Online Applications
Last Date for Submission of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in and click on ‘Apply => Online Registration’.
Step 1 – Registration: Fill in basic information such as Name, Date of Birth, Category, Email, and Mobile Number. An activation link will be sent to your registered email.
Step 2 – Activation: Click on the activation link received via email to activate your account.

Step 3 – Fill Application: Login using your Login ID and Password. Fill in all details including Educational Qualifications, Marks of CA/CMA, Personal Details, and upload scanned Photograph (JPEG, max 50KB, max 480×640 pixels, min 10KB, min 180×240 pixels) and Signature (JPEG, max 20KB, max 160×560 pixels, min 80×100 pixels).
Step 4 – Submit Application: Review the draft application, make any necessary corrections, and submit. An Application Number will be generated upon successful submission.
Step 5 – Print Application Form: After submission, view and print the Online Application Form.
There is NO application fee for applying for the Internship.
Do NOT send any documents/application to NPCIL by post or in person.

title: RITES Recruitment 2026 – Manager, DGM, Assistant Manager Posts
shortInfo: RITES has announced notification for Manager, DGM, Assistant Manager posts. Required qualification: M.Sc, B.Tech/B.E. Last date to apply: 08-10-26.

dates.event: Commencement of submission of online application and online payment of fees
Last date of submission of online application and online payment of fees

howToApply: Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position.
Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website: http://www.rites.com.

While submitting the online application, the system would generate a ‘Registration No.’ on top of the online form filled up by the candidate. Note down this Registration No. for further logging in and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
Carefully and correctly fill all the details as required in the application form.

After filling up the required details under ‘Fill/Modify Application Form’, upload all documents under the ‘Upload Document’ section including: High School certificate (Date of Birth proof), Academic & Professional qualification certificates and mark sheets, Percentage Conversion Document (if applicable), EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate (if applicable), Proof of Identity & Address, PAN Card, Proof of experience, PwBD Certificate (if applicable), and any other supporting documents.
After uploading all documents, make online payment under the ‘Make Payment’ section.
Post successful payment of application fee, download and keep a copy of the final application form for future reference.
Candidates working in Government organizations/PSUs on regular basis are required to apply through proper channel and bring NOC at the time of Interview.
Submit only one application for one vacancy; application once submitted cannot be altered.
Hard copies of documents are NOT to be sent to the office through post/courier.

fees.fee: ₹500 (non-refundable, exclusive of transaction processing charges and GST)

howToApply: Visit the NCRTC website, www.ncrtc.in, and click on the “Career” link.
Open the relevant recruitment notification – “Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026” or “Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026” – depending on the post you wish to apply for.
Go through the eligibility, age criteria, and other conditions carefully before proceeding.
Register first; on successful registration, an application number/login ID and password will be generated and sent to your email and mobile number.
From 10.09.2026 onward, log in and fill the application form with all details (age, personal details, educational qualification, etc.).

Upload a recent passport-size colour photo (100–200 KB, JPG/JPEG), a recent scanned signature (80–150 KB, JPG/JPEG), and category/caste certificates plus educational and other certificates (100–1000 KB, JPG/JPEG/PDF).
Preview the application form carefully – once submitted, it cannot be edited.
Complete the fee payment (if applicable) via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking; only after successful payment will a payment acknowledgment with a unique application number be generated.
Submit the application before 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs); it is advised to apply at least two days before the closing date to avoid transaction failures.
